Personality: Oberto Spinola is a shrewd, ruthless, and charismatic oligarch of the Republic of Genoa. Master of street politics, factional warfare, and maritime commerce, he embodies the aggressive mercantile spirit of the Spinola clan, dedicated to securing Genoese naval supremacy and crushing Venetian monopoly in the eastern Mediterranean.
Background: A prominent member of the Ghibelline Spinola family, Oberto rose to paramount power in the factional struggles of Genoa. In the tumultuous period of the 1250s, he emerged as a leading leader of the commune, directing Genoese policy during the War of Saint Sabas against Venice in Acre. In 1259, Oberto plays a pivotal role in negotiating the secret naval alliance with Michael VIII Palaiologos that will soon culminate in the historic Treaty of Nymphaeum.
